title: SCE 3.3 Preventive Probe — Permission Boundary and IMDSv2 Enforcement Block Full Attack Chain (T1578 + T1552.005 + T1078.004)
description: Validates that all three preventive controls in the banking platform's defense architecture block their respective attack steps before any state change occurs. Step 1.2 (T1578): An AttackerRole with a scoped IAM Permission Boundary attempts ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to weaken IMDS (HttpTokens=optional, HopLimit=2) on a CFn-provisioned EC2 instance; the call must be denied and the instance IMDS configuration must remain HttpTokens=required / HopLimit=1. Step 2.2 (T1552.005): An IMDSProbe Lambda running in the same VPC private subnet attempts an unauthenticated IMDSv1 curl to the instance's private IP; IMDSv2 enforcement and a NACL deny on 169.254.169.254 egress must block the credential harvest. Step 3.2 (T1078.004): A SimulatedAttacker Lambda assumes the AttackerRole and attempts each lateral-movement and privilege-escalation action from the attack YAML (iam:CreateUser, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:CreatePolicy, iam:ListRoles, ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, s3:GetObject on PCI bucket, sts:AssumeRole); the Permission Boundary must deny every privileged action while allowing the baseline sts:GetCallerIdentity. Hypothesis verification performs four sub-checks: (a) IMDS modify denied + EC2 state unchanged, (b) IMDS harvest blocked, (c) all privileged actions denied in live Lambda execution, (d) all privileged actions denied confirmed independently via IAM SimulatePrincipalPolicy. All resources are provisioned and destroyed within a single timestamped CloudFormation stack.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Permission Boundary and IMDSv2 enforcement block all three attack steps with no state change on the EC2 instance or AWS account
